import java.io.StringReader;

public final class LearnerProbe {
    private LearnerProbe() {}
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (Main.TokenReader in = new Main.TokenReader(new StringReader("3\n2 3 1\n1 3 2\n1 2 3\n"))) {
            int[][] input = Main.readInput(in);
            assert input.length == 3 && Main.rankOf(input[0], 2) == 0;
            assert Main.rankOf(input[0], 1) == 2;
            assert Main.formatAnswers(input, new int[] {2, 1, 1}).equals("2\n1\n1\n");
            assert Main.formatAnswers(input, new int[] {1, 2, 3}).equals("1\n2\n3\n");
            try {
                Main.formatAnswers(input, new int[] {2, 1, 4});
                throw new AssertionError("Out-of-range gift accepted.");
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("range");
            }
            try {
                Main.formatAnswers(new int[][] {{1, 2}, {2, 1}}, new int[] {2, 1});
                throw new AssertionError("A worse gift was accepted.");
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("no worse");
            }
            try {
                Main.reachability(input);
                throw new AssertionError("Reachability task must remain unfinished.");
            } catch (UnsupportedOperationException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("reachability");
            }
            try {
                Main.bestGifts(input, new boolean[3][3]);
                throw new AssertionError("Best gift task must remain unfinished.");
            } catch (UnsupportedOperationException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("bestGifts");
            }
        }
        System.out.println("Supplied helpers and unfinished tasks verified.");
    }
}
